cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives the share of people using the internet in rural and in urban areas; the KDHS 2022 figures predate the window.
cells.note: The Universal Service Fund had 155 of 369 targeted sub-locations connected by August 2025, up from 76 in 2021, and 1,300 km of rural fibre was laid by September 2024, so a programme is delivering. No rural and urban internet use figures from the window are held, so not 4.
